learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 295 sitemap URLs, 68 New York flavor pages (slug ending -NY or -ny, sometimes with a random suffix), 67 after dropping a case-twin. Botanica blends and live resin only; no NY pages for solventless or straincraft.
notes: turn.me is a Next.js site over a Strapi CMS with no public API. The flavor listing pages render a default California list (the state is picked client-side), so the New York pages are read one by one from the sitemap.

Some pages (the newer ones, with a random slug suffix such as atomic-purple-dispo-NY-0lumvy) are rendered client-side: the body is empty and the product is only in the React flight payload in <script> tags. Every page has that payload, so line, format and size are read from the script text, and the name from <title> ('<name> turn disposable flavor', '<name> turn podpak flavor'), which is server-rendered on both kinds. The canonical link and og:url point to the home page, so there is no per-page URL to read.

Payload fields: 'oil type: ' then the line ('botanica blends' or 'live resin'); 'device type: ' then 'ready-to-vape pen' (an all-in-one) or 'podpak podpen' (a pod), then ', 1.0g' (the retrovision disposables say 2.0g).

The sitemap lists the-mandarin-dispo-NY and the-mandarin-dispo-ny, the same page; the match drops the lowercase twin. A new case-twin would be collapsed by the script (one entry per product and size).
Names on the site are lowercase ('gdp', 'pb & j', 'dragon fruit açaí'); '(21+)' after 'unicorn party' is dropped.

NY stores often record turn's 'Up' and 'Down' effect labels as the product line ('Up GMO Funk', 'Down Banana OG'), which the site never uses; those store products show as only at stores although the site has them under Live Resin or Botanica Blends.
Stores put turn's Up/Down effect labels in the line field; store_aliases drops them, so those products are the site's (confirmed: GMO Funk, Banana OG, GDP, Cherry Bomb, Mango x Guava).

2026-10-08 curation: stores sell turn's NY 'sour apple' botanica blends AIO as 'Sour Apple Soda' (the NY pack reads 'sour apple soda'; the site's sour-apple-dispo-NY page carries the same taste/feeling/memory as sour-apple-seltzer-dispo: sweet & tart, bubbly, weekend vibes; Weedmaps' turn page slug turn-sour-apple-seltzer-s-hybrid-1g-pod is titled 'Sour Apple'). store_aliases.names maps it to the site's Sour Apple.

2026-10-08 curation: up/down is the effect label printed on every turn pack ('up | sativa', 'down | indica') beside the 'botanica blends' or 'live resin' badge; it is never a line. Store-only pods the stores record as Up/Down are botanica blends pods (Cherry Bomb, Hot Girl Summer, Blue Dream, Mango x Guava) and need their line set by admin edit: aliases only change the comparison with the site. turn also sells a Straincraft pod line (King Louis XIII) that has no NY page on the site.
